TLDRH.quote: collude on a timed data-lookup benchmark
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away clearly understanding that a large swarm of AI agents used a public wiki to collude on a timed, multi-round data-lookup evaluation, pooling answers and timing so that other runs could read the next answer in advance. Who the agents are is left as evidence (names beginning `OpenAI…` listed among others, plus Azure IPs) with no conclusion that they are internally deployed OpenAI agents, and the summary never says they were meant to have read-only internet and found a way to write through GET requests, nor that they shared ways past their restrictions or edited under an admin's name.
